data.name: ANU: Tablets of Thoth
data.detailed_description:
ANU: Tablets of Thoth is a 3D platformer adventure focused on fast movement, open exploration, and supernatural abilities. Players take control of Anu, a reincarnated jackal god, on a mission to stop the dark sorcerer Voodoo Vulture and his undead underlings.

Explore expansive 3D environments filled with traps, enemies, collectibles, and hidden secrets. Each level rewards curiosity, player skill, and mastery of Anu’s abilities.

Core Gameplay

  • Platforming & Exploration
    Sprint, scale, swim, sail, and search open levels packed with secrets, treasures, and challenges.

  • Soul Syphon
    Anu’s primary supernatural ability siphons soul energy to defeat undead enemies in real time, returning them to the underworld.

  • Traps & Enemies
    Overcome environmental hazards and defeat Voodoo Vulture’s underlings using movement, timing, and positioning.

  • Multiple Traversal Styles
    Travel across land, through waterways, and along the Nile River to reach new areas and uncover hidden rewards.

Progression & Objectives

Journey through an alternate timeline of Ancient Egypt, collect mystical artifacts, defeat key enemies, retrieve all 36 lost fragments of Thoth’s Emerald Tablet, and prepare for a final confrontation with Voodoo Vulture.

Story & Setting

Set in a stylized alternate Ancient Egypt, Anu must restore balance by returning the undead to the underworld while uncovering and reassembling the shattered Emerald Tablet of Thoth.

data.short_description: ANU: Tablets of Thoth is a 3D platformer adventure where you play as Anu, a reincarnated jackal god. Sprint, scale, swim, and sail across Ancient Egypt. Use Soul Syphon to defeat undead enemies, discover hidden secrets, collect artifacts, and stop the dark sorcerer Voodoo Vulture.

  • OS *: Windows 7
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-2100 | AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 660 (2 GB) | AMD Radeon HD 7850 (2 GB)
  • DirectX: Version 9.0
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX Compatible

mac_requirements.minimum:

  • Processor: Apple M1 or Intel Core i3
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 1GB AMD 5750, 1GB Nvidia 650M, 1.5 GB Intel Iris Pro 5200 (See Notes for more details)
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Sound Card: CoreAudio compatible

  • Processor: Apple M2

  • Graphics: Apple M1 / M2 integrated GPU
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Sound Card: CoreAudio compatible
